content: Concentration is the secret of strength in politics, in war, in trade, in short in all management of human affairs.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Energy dispersed across fifty directions achieves nothing memorable. True power is the laser-like focalization of attention and will upon a single worthy objective.
practicalInsight: Eliminate two non-essential distractions today and give your single most important project your undivided focus.
reflectionPrompt: What single endeavor deserves your undivided, concentrated effort this week?
